item.title: The Startup Guide Moves into the Documentation
item.description: The Salix Startup Guide is now part of our documentation site. You can find it at docs.salixos.org/guide, as the first section in the documentation menu. A bit of history first. Back in 2014, we had to rewrite the guide in a new format, because Publican, the tool we were using before, would not work on Salix anymore. I wrote about it in a previous blog post. We switched to txt2tags, which could produce HTML, as well as LaTeX for a PDF version, from the same source files.

item.title: New Startup Guide
item.description: We’ve been working on this for a while and were hoping to have it ready by the time 14.1 is released and it seems that we managed to make it! You can now find the new guide linked from our main website. The startup guide was left with no updates since the 13.37 release, so it was getting a bit old. It was still mostly OK, but there were things that were out of date.
